title: Execute temporary switch_pt abilities through the accepted Layer 7e foundation

parent_overlay.apply_mode: fresh isolated clone only; apply through scripts/map-pipeline-apply.py --allow-game before packet preparation

evidence.fact: Ground truth proves only self, target-creature, and each-creature switch_pt scopes.
The Layer 7e SwitchPT representation and behavior tests are accepted for dependent observation, but have not been integrated into source.
Ability-effect dispatch has neighboring temporary P/T effect paths but no switch_pt case or executor.
The parent overlay supplies the SwitchPT continuous-effect flag, registration, and existing UntilEOT cleanup semantics.

required_behavior: Add a switch_pt dispatch case and a narrow executor that registers the parent foundation's SwitchPT effect with UntilEOT true; it must not duplicate P/T layer logic.
Support exactly the pre-proven self (no targets), target-creature, and each-creature scopes. Ignore noncreature/noncard target entries without changing other permanents.
Use existing target and battlefield mechanisms; do not add parser, converter, registry, or Map behavior.

Create at least one TestSwitchPTExecution* behavior test through ExecuteAbilityEffect. It must prove a 2/5 with a +1/+2 temporary effect becomes 7/3, and UntilEOT cleanup restores the normal computed 3/7.
The child must consume the parent SwitchPT representation; direct SetPower/SetToughness snapshots are forbidden.
gates: baseline-relative gofmt for ability_effects.go; switch_pt_execution_test.go has no gofmt drift
cd backend && go test ./game -list '^TestSwitchPTExecution' -count=1 lists at least one test
git diff --name-only contains the parent-overlay paths plus only the allowed child paths

execution.selection_reason: The parent has removed the hard layering design problem. This child is now bounded Engine wiring with three ground-truth scopes; run it in the same staged expert adapter so the model sees the accepted parent implementation in a clone, not a hypothetical API.

on_failure: Record an immutable receipt. Do not broaden into parsing or Map changes; any missing parent capability is a new child ticket.
